tools.name: google_drive_list
tools.description: List the user's most recently modified, non-trashed Google Drive files. This is read-only and returns a limited page. `max_results` and the number of returned rows are never exact match counts when `hasMore` is true. Never count those rows or present them as exact bulk-action totals. Results include file name, type, modified date, owners, and web link.

max_results.description: Maximum number of files to return. Defaults to 5.

query.description: Optional Google Drive full-text search query.

order_by.description: Optional compatibility hint. Results are always ordered by modified time descending, regardless of this value.
